GracePrinciples.Principle: Contract first: issue, approved GraceChangeSpec, approved GraceChangePlan, scoped implementation and fresh verification precede merge.
One authoritative domain record remains identifiable; derived calendar, search and report records are rebuildable projections.
Documents and evidence remain immutable; corrections create revisions and audit rather than erasing provenance.
Database migrations are append-only, sequential, transactional and verified from the exact base SHA to the exact tested SHA.
Every schema change proves repeated migration, PRAGMA quick_check, PRAGMA foreign_key_check, backup/restore and rollback readiness.
Approved plans are immutable; changed intent or scope requires superseding and replanning.
Merge evidence is tied to an exact SHA and fails closed on missing, pending, skipped, cancelled or failed checks.
